newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers $50 mln export credits to West Africa.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers $50 mln export credits to West Africa.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday it had offered $50 million in credit guarantees for exports of U.S. farm commodities to West African countries for fiscal 1997.
The coverage under the GSM-102 program included $1.5 million for breeder livestock.
The remaining $48.5 million was for feed grains, rice, wheat, wheat flour, oilseeds, vegetable oils, protein meals, frozen or chilled meat and dairy products.

The countries covered are Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Cape Verde, Central African Republic, Congo, Ivory Coast, Gabon, Gambia, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea, Liberia, Mali, Mauritania, Nigeria, Senegal, Sierra Leone and Togo.
